subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '4'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0023422546d6b67403c06f3cf27874528abe500614730a1a6f0739a5d954e987.png]
solution:
As per the given position of the dice, the opposite faces are as:

**Logic:** 'Written numbers in the clockwise direction from the common number 3 from the first two positions of dice'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52b0fbe505381c1be9db105e0116aab265b0ee386de60fa67dde0ce07324ef9b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d243b6bbbcba4bb06d66e3b92c040dd471b8da9303496a4bc1e76db8c562c156.png] 

Here, 3 is the opposite face of 4.

Hence, the correct answer is "3".
